## The prompt it sends

This is what the tool asks a model, with every option left at its default. Changing the options above changes this text.

```text
Classify the artistic/document style of this image.

Choose ONE primary style from: photograph, oil_painting, watercolor, drawing, digital_art, print, manuscript, engraving, lithograph, screen_capture, diagram, map

Also analyze:
- Medium/technique used
- Color palette characteristics
- Approximate era/period if identifiable
- Notable stylistic features

Return as JSON:
{
    "style": "<primary style>",
    "medium": "<specific medium or technique>",
    "palette": "<warm/cool/muted/vibrant/monochrome>",
    "era": "<approximate period if identifiable>",
    "features": ["<notable stylistic features>"]
}

Return ONLY valid JSON.
```
